deliverables.text: An invoice PDF shows the total the ledger stores, to the cent.
An invoice note reaches the PDF as it was typed, `</script><!-- x -->` and all.
`$&`, `$1` and `$$` in an invoice print as the literal text, not as what the template engine makes of them.
The three customers with a wrong invoice have a corrected one.
deliverables.reason: finance sent them by hand, invoice notes such as `</script><!-- x -->` and `$&` included
